items.html: Let us return to the matter of the verse “Open Your eyes.” For when the discernment of the eye came, which are the Nekudot, then it was said, “Open Your eyes,” for then there was an opening of the eyes. Now, it has already been explained that all these discernments are in the name SAG, and this name alludes to Bina, which is the upper Gevura, on which the judgments depend; therefore in this discernment of SAG the matter of the annulment of the kings took place. Also, within SAG itself in particular there is the discernment of the Taamim, which are likewise called AB even though they are in SAG; but the Nekudot of SAG are the essence of SAG itself, being SAG of SAG, and there the annulment and the death took place. And this is what is written, “All of it together is SAG,” for in the name SAG was the whole annulment. And SAG itself indicates this, for it is from the expression “they were turned back” [Nasogu Achor], which is the annulment of the kings.
